description: Keeps long sessions workable: hides older large tool outputs from requests; /hidden_outputs lists them, recall restores them

commands.name: hidden_outputs
commands.description: See which tool outputs are hidden from requests and how many prompt-cache breaks that cost

mode.title: When to hide outputs
mode.description: Automatic batches, or only a successful /continue after estimated cache expiry (/continue --compact forces it). Continue mode needs the omd_continue mod and has no estimate on ChatGPT plans, so only --compact hides there

cache_ttl_minutes.title: Estimated cache lifetime
cache_ttl_minutes.description: Used in continue mode; auto skips OpenAI subscriptions and unpriced responses, and uses provider-reported lifetimes or a 30-minute OpenAI API estimate; 720 is OpenAI's 12-hour cache

keep_recent.title: Recent outputs kept
keep_recent.description: Newest tool outputs always sent in full (at least 1)

min_bytes.title: Minimum size
min_bytes.description: Outputs smaller than this many bytes are never hidden

batch_bytes.title: Batch size
batch_bytes.description: Bytes of hideable outputs to collect before hiding them at once; 0 hides each as soon as it is old enough
